name: NEONTRIP DHL Arrival Email Dry Run v0.1 (INACTIVE)

parameters.content:
## DHL arrival email trigger – Dry Run only

Polls the existing support Outlook inbox every minute and forwards only allowlisted DHL-domain messages to the tested Ops dry-run service. It cannot call EasyDPD, Shopify mutations or a printer. The separate daily workflow remains the reconciliation path.
